evals.prompt: Make a skill that lets the agent query our Jira with my API token and summarise sprint risk.
evals.expected_output: Recommends an MCP server (auth + live data) paired with a thin skill; token never in the skill
expectations: Decision names an MCP server (or existing Jira MCP) for auth/live data
No API token or secret appears in any created SKILL.md
lint_skill.py exits 0 on the created skill

evals.prompt: Create a deploy skill that supports AWS, GCP and Azure.
evals.expected_output: One skill with references per provider, user-invoked only
expectations: Exactly one new skill directory is created, with references/aws.md, references/gcp.md, references/azure.md (or equivalent)
The skill is user-invoked only on each target host, using that host's own switch, and the report names where the switch was looked up or marks it unverified
Destructive steps go through a validate script before apply

evals.prompt: Review the changelog-writer skill in .agents/skills/ before we share it with other teams.
evals.expected_output: Lint run first; findings reported against the rules, including the planted defects; trigger/task evals proposed since it has none
expectations: lint_skill.py was run on the skill before any edit
Report flags the missing evals/evals.json and evals/trigger_evals.json
Report flags the interactive prompt in scripts/collect.py
Report flags that scripts/format_entries.py and references/style.md do not exist
Every reported issue cites a concrete file/line or lint message

evals.prompt: Add a rule that we always run ruff before committing.
evals.expected_output: Recommends a hook or always-on rule, not a skill, and stops
expectations: No new skill directory is created
Response recommends an always-on rule or AGENTS.md entry
Creates or recommends an enforcement mechanism (git/agent hook), not only an instruction, because 'always' means it must happen every time

evals.prompt: Create a plain skill (no plugin) that formats our release notes. Each team needs to set its own heading style and the maximum number of bullets, and I want my own default on my machine.
evals.expected_output: A skill whose script resolves the two settings from layered config outside the skill folder
expectations: SKILL.md frontmatter holds no setting values
A script reads the settings from files outside the installed skill folder, with a project file and a user file, and a flag or environment variable that overrides both
An unusable value produces an error naming the file and the field; the script does not fall back to the default silently
lint_skill.py exits 0 on the created skill
